description.en: Turns a character's ground contact on (true: it stays on the ground below it) or off (false: it keeps the height it is given). Two optional values (default 40.0 and 100.0) are stored with it; by their use they are probably how far above and below the ground is looked for.

true once set, false if the object is not found.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Keeping a character on the ground (real usage, from ev42010450.nut)
